recognize_zh: 周邊血中一個比紅血球略大的淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質均勻，胞質淡藍灰色且整圈邊緣呈細毛狀突起（hairy projections），這是毛狀細胞白血病的毛狀細胞。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cell, about 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Fine, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections along the cell border
Background red cells normochromic; no other leukocytes in the field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, homogeneous chromatin without a visible nucleolus, and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. The surrounding red cells show no specific abnormality. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell; correlation with pancytopenia, monocytopenia, flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123, bright CD20) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended to confirm hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi concentrated at one or both poles and are CD103 and CD25 negative.
HCL-variant cells have a prominent central nucleolus and are CD25, CD123 and annexin A1 negative with wild-type BRAF.

ddx.dx: Smear or drying artifact on a normal lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Artifactual cytoplasmic fraying is uneven and seen in neighbouring cells, whereas hairy projections are fine, circumferential and reproducible in well-made areas.
